boundary: All numeric experiments in this file are constructed/local research proxies unless an external runtime result is explicitly referenced. They do not establish live FRANK performance or production security.

experiments.interpretation: When the semantic read is a negative predicate such as 'no matching record exists', two transactions can insert distinct row/object IDs and violate uniqueness while ordinary object-version OCC sees no shared object conflict. Predicate/invariant witnesses detect the constructed conflict; a whole-state root is safe but overconservative in this pair model.

Independent execution replicated the constructed mechanism: object-only tracking missed every negative-predicate conflict while the predicate witness caught every such conflict. This replicates the mechanism on a separate runtime, not a real FRANK workload frequency.

A complete observed trace can narrow validation sharply relative to a conservative static upper bound, but observed-only validation becomes unsound when dynamic accesses escape monitoring. Therefore trace must be checked as a subset of a trusted static envelope, with fail-closed escalation on escapes.

Object access traces alone do not represent time/current-regime/random/external-snapshot dependencies. Volatile inputs must become explicit versioned/receipt dependencies when they can affect semantics.

Monitoring after an irreversible effect can detect but cannot undo the effect. External side effects require pre-effect interposition plus current capability/freshness checks; post-hoc trace auditing is not an authority boundary.

The research reference's typed class-wise subset check rejected every deliberately undeclared object/predicate/invariant/volatile/effect/capability access in this generated workload. This tests the checker logic only, not completeness of a production compiler/interposer.

Under the constructed crash/retry model, atomically persisting state plus effect intent prevents the naive dual-write loss mode, while at-least-once relay introduces duplicates that require idempotency. This is a pattern sanity check, not a production reliability estimate.
